into-broken-file.$description: References a path that would live in unparseable.tokens.json — that file fails to parse entirely, so this reference is unresolved rather than found, and the rest of this file (and every other file) must still resolve normally

unaffected-sibling.$description: A normal, resolvable reference in the same file as the one above — proves one bad file doesn't stop this file's other references from resolving
